name: Stoke Space
oneLine: Reusable-rocket startup: black canvas, ultra-wide display caps, and test-stand footage presented like a launch broadcast.

palette.note: Pure black page ground behind all footage and sections
Off-white for display headline, nav and body copy
Nav capsule fill (white at ~5% over black), turns translucent over imagery
Accordion row titles at ~30% white alpha until active
Glowing orange plus-sign menu button on mobile, echoes engine flame
Magenta-to-blue dusk gradient under the X-ray rocket illustration

type.note: 78px bold extended all-caps, very tight leading (~0.95), set bottom-left over video; 56px for section heads
16-19px weight 300 sentence case, airy, used for nav, accordion titles and paragraphs
11px weight 500 for small captions and legal text

layout: Hero video inset below a 140px black header band, headline overlapping the lower-left of the footage.
Two-column component section: 700px photo on the left, hairline-divided accordion (Stage 1 Engine, Reentry Heat Shield...) with thin plus icons on the right.
Full-width horizontal X-ray rocket illustration spanning edge to edge on a dusk gradient, with text in the right half column above it.
motion: Hero is an autoplay video of an engine hot-fire test with steam venting.
A thin progress bar runs along the top-left edge (visible ~190px line at top) tracking scroll or video progress.
(inferred) The X-ray rocket diagram is scroll-driven, highlighting components as the accordion items open.
(inferred) Nav capsule shifts from solid to translucent blur as it passes over imagery, as seen over the sky photo.
interactions: Accordion of vehicle subsystems with thin crosshair plus icons that rotate/expand.
Text link CTA 'Let's Launch →' instead of a filled button.
Mobile menu as an orange glowing crosshair plus.
steal: Hairline accordion with crosshair plus icons for our pipeline stages (preprocessing, encoder, detector, evaluation) beside a static diagram on the methods page.
A horizontal 'X-ray' cutaway of the satellite/ESA mission with subsystems lit as the user selects telemetry channels, for the dataset section.
Thin top-edge scroll-progress hairline across the long research write-up page.
leave: Druk Wide all-caps headlines: so heavy it reads as aerospace marketing bravado and is a common space-site cliche; our research tone should be quieter.
A cookie banner that covers a quarter of the hero on desktop and the headline on mobile.

screenshots.caption: Engine hot-fire hero; cookie banner covers bottom-right

X-ray rocket illustration on dusk gradient; cookie banner visible
